list.name: route
list.label: Route
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT route FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY route
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT route FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY route

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, client, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, client ORDER BY time
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, route, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, route ORDER BY time
SELECT route, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY route ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT concat(toString(intDiv(status,100)),'xx') AS status_class, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY status_class

panels.title: Most used features

targets.rawSql: SELECT transform(splitByChar('/', route)[4], ['users','groups','waterways','gauges','descents','materials','geo','proposals','trips','search','map','brands','water-status','regions','catalog'], ['Account and follows','Groups','Rivers and sections','Gauges','Logbook','Gear wiki','Map data','Proposals','Trips','Search','Map','Gear brands','Water status','Regions','Catalog'], splitByChar('/', route)[4]) AS feature, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND route != 'unmatched' GROUP BY feature ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Requests grouped by the first path segment after /api/v1 (users, waterways, gauges, ...) under readable names. Counts requests, not people.

panels.title: Latency p50 and p95 by route

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, route, quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95 FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, route ORDER BY time

SELECT route, count() AS requests, quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY route HAVING requests >= 5 ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT route, status, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND status >= 400 GROUP BY route, status ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Filter usage (category, discipline, construction, sort)

targets.rawSql: SELECT key, value, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events ARRAY JOIN mapKeys(query) AS key, mapValues(query) AS value WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY key, value ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 30

panels.description: How often each closed-set filter value is used. Values outside the known list show as other.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, status_class, sum(requests) AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour <= $__toTime GROUP BY time, status_class ORDER BY time

panels.title: Requests by browser

targets.rawSql: SELECT browser, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY browser ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.description: Coarse browser or client family from the User-Agent; no versions, raw header never stored.

panels.title: Requests by operating system

targets.rawSql: SELECT os, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY os ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.description: Coarse OS family from the User-Agent; no versions, raw header never stored.

panels.title: Feature trend per week
panels.description: Requests per feature and week, stacked: which parts of the app grow and which fade.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfWeek(ts, 1)) AS time, transform(splitByChar('/', route)[4], ['users','groups','waterways','gauges','descents','materials','geo','proposals','trips','search','map','brands','water-status','regions','catalog'], ['Account and follows','Groups','Rivers and sections','Gauges','Logbook','Gear wiki','Map data','Proposals','Trips','Search','Map','Gear brands','Water status','Regions','Catalog'], splitByChar('/', route)[4]) AS feature, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND route != 'unmatched' GROUP BY time, feature ORDER BY time

panels.title: Wiki funnel
panels.description: How far people get in the gear wiki: browsing the list or tree, opening a model, comparing models, then suggesting a change or adding a photo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(method != 'GET', '4 Suggest or add photo', mapContains(query, 'ids'), '3 Compare', route LIKE '/api/v1/materials/{material_id}%', '2 Model page', '1 Browse') AS step, count() AS requests FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND route LIKE '/api/v1/materials%' GROUP BY step ORDER BY step

panels.title: When the app is used (weekday x hour, Berlin time)
panels.description: Requests per weekday and hour of day; darker cells are busier.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'][toDayOfWeek(ts, 0, 'Europe/Berlin')] AS day, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 0) AS `00`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 1) AS `01`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 2) AS `02`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 3) AS `03`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 4) AS `04`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 5) AS `05`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 6) AS `06`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 7) AS `07`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 8) AS `08`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 9) AS `09`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 10) AS `10`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 11) AS `11`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 12) AS `12`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 13) AS `13`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 14) AS `14`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 15) AS `15`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 16) AS `16`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 17) AS `17`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 18) AS `18`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 19) AS `19`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 20) AS `20`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 21) AS `21`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 22) AS `22`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Berlin') = 23) AS `23` FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY toDayOfWeek(ts, 0, 'Europe/Berlin') AS dow, day ORDER BY dow

panels.title: Server error rate (5xx, %)
panels.description: Share of requests that ended in a server error. The dashed line is 2%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, round(100 * countIf(status >= 500) / count(), 2) AS error_pct FROM paddlemate.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
